records.definition: ISNetworld's label for written safety programs reviewed as part of a contractor file.
A platform term whose current meaning must be confirmed in the contractor's own account.
Management System Questionnaire; answers may affect which written-program tasks appear.
The statistics portion of an ISNetworld file in the terminology used by the domain specification.
Total Recordable Incident Rate, calculated from recordable incidents and hours worked.
A rate based on cases involving days away, restricted work, or job transfer and hours worked.
Lost Time Incident Rate, calculated from lost-time cases and hours worked.
Experience Modification Rate shown on an annual carrier or rating-bureau document.
A standard certificate of liability insurance form.
An insurance status or endorsement that may be requested by a hiring client.
Insurance wording that may be requested by a hiring client.
